## Working Read

This is the most directly infrastructure-like attention essay in the feed: it turns the attention engine into a reentry artifact that can be carried into a wiki without losing the comparator logic.

The key move is to treat attention engineering as a way to stabilize mutual projection and correct wrong-side error, not merely to increase output.

## Core Claim

Attention becomes operational when it is grounded by comparators, witnesses, and consent-to-context rather than by raw amplification.

## Key Ideas

- Attention can be serialized into a book-series or curriculum surface.
- Comparator grounding prevents wrong-side projection.
- Consent-to-context keeps the system from treating every signal as authorization.

## Semantic Extraction Notes

The essay is a three-scale Attention Engine reentry artifact:

- **Book I — The Attention Engine:** attention forms personal lived worlds by selecting distinctions, creating traces, and fossilizing repeated focus into artifacts and structure.
- **Book II — The Surface of Mutual Projection:** attention forms relational meaning on a Möbius-shaped semantic surface where intention, reception, memory, expectation, and response recursively alter one another.
- **Book III — Consentful Reality Engineering:** attention forms shared worlds only when crossing is consented, evaluation is grounded by a disclosed comparator and expectation set, and returnability is preserved by witness.

The central correction is that attention is reality-forming but not automatically truth-forming, care-forming, or coherence-forming. “The field” is not a self-authenticating authority. A grounded attention claim must disclose the comparator, expectation set, consequence trace, and the party or process authorized to revise the frame.

The stabilizing stack is `🜁` openness → `🝁` consent to context → attention allocation → `🜃` grounding through comparator and expectation-set disclosure → `🜹` witness and returnability. Breach of `🝁` produces wrong-side error by repairing a visible symptom while the missing context remains unnamed; breach of `🜃` lets a hidden comparator masquerade as fact.

The parenting example is a reusable diagnostic rather than a parenting-specific rule: “paying attention” changes meaning under protection, present-signal, autonomy, trauma-repair, and trust-over-time comparators. The ethical move is therefore comparator disclosure and negotiability, not a claim to possess the one real field.

The essay also names a book-matrix seam: each artifact should be mapped to book, candidate chapter, primary concepts, current strength, revision needs, and reentry priority. That makes the page useful as a curriculum and synthesis index, not only as an essay record.
